answer: Steel wire coils on the needlesmith's bench, bright in the lamplight. pigment draws the wire through the plate and cuts it to length. Proof of needlesmith via steel needle tally — a needle the needlesmith files only after 619 needles file true without one snapping at the eye, each filed by the needlesmith himself. raven files the point sharp and drills the eye. dune tempers the needles and polishes them bright. Six hundred and nineteen needles must file true without one snapping at the eye, and the next still snaps where the steel ran brittle.
